tools.name: loyjoy_list_agents
tools.description: List all agents (LoyJoy processes) of the tenant with id, name, folder and state. Roles: owner, editor, processes_editor or processes_viewer.

tools.name: loyjoy_get_agent
tools.description: Get one agent (process) by id: its id and name, read from the latest saved (staging) version. Roles: owner, editor, processes_editor or processes_viewer.

tools.name: loyjoy_start_agent
tools.description: Start the published version of an agent with optional variables, and return the resulting variables. The agent halts when it expects user input, for example at a Proceed module. Roles: owner or editor.

tools.name: loyjoy_ask_agent
tools.description: Send one user message to the published (production) agent in a new single-use conversation, and return its answer. Roles: owner or editor.

tools.name: loyjoy_list_home_views
tools.description: List all home views of the tenant with id and name. Roles: owner, editor, processes_editor or processes_viewer.

tools.name: loyjoy_get_home_view
tools.description: Get one home view by id, with its id and name. Roles: owner, editor, processes_editor or processes_viewer.

tools.name: loyjoy_list_catalogs
tools.description: List all knowledge catalogs of the tenant with id, name and updated_at. Roles: owner, editor, knowledge_editor, knowledge_exporter or knowledge_viewer.

tools.name: loyjoy_get_catalog
tools.description: Get one knowledge catalog by id: its metadata only. Its articles come from loyjoy_list_articles. Roles: owner, editor, knowledge_editor, knowledge_exporter or knowledge_viewer.

tools.name: loyjoy_list_articles
tools.description: List all articles of one knowledge catalog. Roles: owner, editor, knowledge_editor, knowledge_exporter or knowledge_viewer.

tools.name: loyjoy_get_article
tools.description: Get one article of a knowledge catalog by id. Roles: owner, editor, knowledge_editor, knowledge_exporter or knowledge_viewer.

tools.name: loyjoy_list_knowledge_sources
tools.description: List all knowledge sources of the tenant, URL and upload kinds, with their folder, type and last indexing time. Roles: owner, editor, knowledge_editor, knowledge_exporter or knowledge_viewer.

tools.name: loyjoy_search_knowledge
tools.description: Search the knowledge chunks of the tenant for a query. Returns up to max_chunks chunks (1 to 100, default 100). The root folder is always searched; subfolders only when listed in folders. Roles: owner, editor, knowledge_editor, knowledge_exporter or knowledge_viewer.

tools.name: loyjoy_create_catalog
tools.description: Create a new, empty knowledge catalog with the given name. Each call creates another catalog. Roles: owner, editor or knowledge_editor.

tools.name: loyjoy_create_article
tools.description: Create an article in a knowledge catalog, in one locale. Writes are limited to one per second per catalog: a faster write returns HTTP 500, so wait about one second between writes to the same catalog. Roles: owner, editor or knowledge_editor.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: loyjoy_list_knowledge_sources · Public sink: loyjoy_ask_agent, loyjoy_list_knowledge_sources.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: loyjoy_list_knowledge_sources · Public sink: loyjoy_ask_agent, loyjoy_list_knowledge_sources

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
